rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A REWARDS PROGRAM FOR INFORMATION ON POLITICAL KILLINGS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Rewards For Information On Political Killings Act
rows.abstract: “Rewards for Information On Political Killings Act.” Seeks to provide a reward system for persons who provide information leading to the arrest or prosecution of those involved in political killings. This can help facilitate enforcement of proper laws in the country. The rewards system proposed by this bill can strongly urge witnesses or persons with knowledge of the crime to come forward and cooperate with appropriate authorities in solving political killings in the country.

rows.title_short: Anti-electricity, Electric Power Lines, Equipment And Materials Pilferage Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: Seeks to provide a new incentive scheme to encourage the public to report pilferage activities to the National Transmission Corporation (TRANSCO), any private electric utility or rural electric cooperative in the area where pilferage is being committed, and seeks to increase the penalties for violation of this Act, with the hope that with a new incentive scheme and increased penalties, violators would be discouraged from doing or continuing their unscrupulous deeds and it is expected that the savings to be enjoyed by the electric sector will redound to the benefits of loyal and honest paying electric consumers who are clamoring for efficient power supply at reasonable rates.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE DEVELOPMENT AND MANAGEMENT OF LAKES IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: Lake Development And Management Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"Lake Development And Management Act Of 2009.\" Seeks to regulate the development and management of approximately 200,000 hectares of freshment bodies in the country formed by volcanic and tectonic process; enhance sustainability of about 211 hectares thorughout the archipelago as a natural resource by reducing vulnerability to hazards caused by human intervention; protect ecosystems from pollution and degradation in view of the heavy demand on the natural resource to sustain the growing population; and, craft a holistic program that define the bounds where the interdependence of human population and the lakes is enhanced despite industrialization, urbanization and population increase.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2009-06-03, transmitted to on 2009-06-23 and received by the Senate on 2009-06-23

second_reading.remarks: On May 26, 2009, the Body approved to consider the Explanatory Note of the Bill as the sponsorship remarks on the measure;terminated the period of sponsorship and debate; terminated the period of amendments; and approved the same on Second Reading.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE DEVELOPMENT AND MANAGEMENT OF SMALL ISLANDS IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: Small Islands Development And Management Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"Small Islands Development And Management Act Of 2009.\" Seeks to provide for a thorough planning aimed at prortecting the resources of small islands from degradation and destruction due to irresponsible development; resolve conflicts in jurisdiction among agencies to pursue the sustainable development of the small islands; determine the scale of development in relation to limitations in resources such as water and coastal resources; reduce the vulnerability of small islands to natural hazards; and, preserve socio-cultural and ecological integrity vis-a-vis development.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2009-06-03, transmitted to on 2009-06-23 and received by the Senate on 2009-06-23

rows.title_short: The Real Estate Investment Trust (reit) Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"The Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Act Of 2009.\" Seeks to democratize wealth by providing small and large investors alike with the opportunity to participate directly in the ownership and financing of large-scale real estate projects at affordable rates of investment, without the disadvantages of illiquidity, high transaction and management costs, as compared to traditional private and real estate ownership; facilitate the buying and selling of securities of said companies representing an interest in income-producing real estate than to directly buy and sell the properties themselves; provide the investor and the national government a steady income stream since the real estate investment trust is required to declare dividends; allow for cross-border investments that will encourage strategic foreign investments in the capital market; and, develop the capital market, reinvigorate the real property markets and improve investor access to property investments.
rows.status: REPUBLIC ACT RA09856 (Lapsed into law on 2009-12-17)
